summary.en: A phone stands still in breathing concentric rings while its feed scrolls by itself; two chips pop out of its sides and hover, and the wordmark rises in the corner.
summary.zh: 手机立在缓慢呼吸的同心圆中，屏内 feed 自动缓滚；两枚胶囊标签先后从两侧弹出并悬浮，字标在角落升起。

fits: The hero shot of a mobile product, or its ending: the app itself, alive, with two things to remember about it.
notFor: Desktop or web products; more than two callouts; screens the viewer has to read in detail (the feed scrolls).

overlaps.note: a product under a spotlight; phone-hero is a phone in rings with a live feed and two callouts
pills popping beside a card; phone-hero pops two chips beside a phone

intent.en: The mobile product, held still yet alive: this is it, and here are the two things to remember.
intent.zh: 移动产品定格但活着：这就是它，再记住两点。

content.en: A tall screenshot of the app (or a neutral feed), two callouts ≤ 18 chars each with optional icons, an optional mark, wordmark ≤ 16 chars and tagline ≤ 34 chars.
content.zh: 一张应用长截图（或中性 feed），两条各 ≤ 7 字的标注（图标可选），可选标志、≤ 6 字的字标和 ≤ 12 字的标语。

fits.zh: 移动产品的主角镜头或片尾：应用本身在动，旁边两点要记住的。

notFor.zh: 桌面或网页产品；多于两条标注；要细读的屏幕（feed 在滚）。

pairs.note: drop the corner wordmark and cut to the full lock-up

en: Keep it slow: speeding up the rings or the feed turns the calm hold into noise.
Without a real app screenshot the neutral feed shows; use the film's own screen.
zh: 要慢：同心圆或 feed 一加速，安静的定格就成了噪声。
没给真实截图就会露出中性 feed；要用片子自己的屏幕。

upstream.name: 同心波纹手机
upstream.summary: 暖沙底四层同心圆错相呼吸如水波，中央手机 mockup 屏内 feed 自动缓滚，两侧白色 chip 先后 spring pop 入场并悬浮
upstream.use: 移动端产品的"这就是它"定格镜头；功能点分列两侧的介绍段；片头/片尾的产品全景
upstream.energy: 低（安静、有呼吸感，靠同心圆的持续起伏撑住不冷场）
